about: #49: a new game on a phone, as a child plays: taps on the stars, a stay near the people of the trials, restless taps, and a long wait. The view lists each sound that played: no sound of the world plays more than four times in a minute, and a person greets one time.
allow: the button Tiếp is under the bottom of the screen

steps.print: (() => { const c = {}; for (const x of tre.activeVillage.sounds()) c[x.name] = (c[x.name] ?? 0) + 1; return c; })()

(() => { const s = tre.activeVillage.sounds().filter((x) => x.id !== 'hero' && !String(x.id).startsWith('zone:')); const m = {}; for (const a of s) { const n = s.filter((b) => b.name === a.name && b.t >= a.t && b.t < a.t + 60).length; m[a.name] = Math.max(m[a.name] ?? 0, n); } return m; })()

steps.check: (() => { const s = tre.activeVillage.sounds().filter((x) => x.id !== 'hero' && !String(x.id).startsWith('zone:')); return s.every((a) => s.filter((b) => b.name === a.name && b.t >= a.t && b.t < a.t + 60).length <= 4); })()
